note: RISK RESEARCH NOT COMPLETED - tooling failure, no findings verified. All fields set to null because nothing could be confirmed from a primary source; nothing here should be read as a clean bill of health. What was attempted: (1) web_search for OFAC/BIS exposure and for NCLT/litigation - the search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both queries; (2) direct fetches of Google, DuckDuckGo HTML and Bing result pages - Google returned HTTP 429, DuckDuckGo timed out, and Bing returned results that were entirely unrelated to the query (Lake Powell pages, then Fanatics retail pages), i.e. the SERP content was corrupted and unusable; (3) the OFAC Sanctions List Search page (https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/) loaded successfully and confirms the SDN list was last updated 11/23/2026 and the Non-SDN list 11/4/2026, but the tool is an interactive form and cannot be queried via a plain GET, so no name match was actually run. Therefore: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List screening result, no Indian court or NCLT record, no regulator action, no credit rating and no Russia/CIS supply evidence was obtained for Milacron India / Ferromatik Milacron India. Context only, NOT verified and NOT to be treated as a finding: the entity appears to be the Indian subsidiary/affiliate of the US plastics-machinery group Milacron (Ferromatik is a German injection-moulding brand), which would normally imply a US-parent compliance posture, but this was not confirmed by any source in this session. Recommended next step: re-run screening when search is restored, specifically (a) OFAC SDN + BIS Entity List name search on 'Milacron' and 'Ferromatik', (b) eCourts/NCLT/CCI dockets, (c) CRISIL/ICRA/CARE rating lookup, (d) Russian import/customs records for plastics machinery. Per project rule 2, any sanctions or litigation findings that do emerge are to be recorded neutrally as 'est slozhnosti' and are not rejection grounds.
